court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Dilip S/O Govindrao Thakre vs Smt. Rekha W/O Dilip Thakre
facts_of_case: The parties were married in 2002. The wife filed a petition under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act for restitution of conjugal rights. The trial court allowed the petition and directed the husband to join her company for cohabitation.

legal_principles.principle: A decree of restitution of conjugal rights should not be passed if the circumstances of the case do not justify it.
legal_principles.held: It is pleaded that in the circumstances of the case, a decree of restitution of conjugal rights should not be passed in favour of the wife.

legal_principles.principle: The court should consider all evidence tendered by parties before passing a decree.
legal_principles.held: The Family Court considered the evidence tendered by the parties and on an appreciation of the same, ...

outcome.final_order: The final order was that the judgment of the Family Court, Nagpur, dated 23.02.2010, was confirmed.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for restitution of conjugal rights
advising on divorce proceedings under Hindu Marriage Act
